channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Caja Laboral | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Caja Laboral from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Pablo Prigioni on Caja Laboral
item.description:
Pablo Prigioni:

“If I have the option (of choosing between Spain and the NBA), I'll try to make a decision, butmy first choice was always to play with Caja Laboral.”

Pablo Prigioni on Caja Laboral, Jun 26, 2012. Source: Basquet Plus.

item.title: Pablo Prigioni on Caja Laboral
item.description:
Pablo Prigioni:

“The Knicks have some situations to take care of and when things clear up they will contact me. My first option is to play for Caja Laboral, but out of respect for both sides I will not talk much about it.”

Pablo Prigioni on Caja Laboral, Jun 26, 2012. Source: 442.

item.title: Andres Nocioni on Caja Laboral
item.description:
Andres Nocioni:

“I don't rule out anything: playing in the NBA, Europe, even keep playing with Caja Laboral.”

Andres Nocioni on Caja Laboral, Jun 4, 2012. Source: Encestando.

item.title: Mirza Teletovic on Caja Laboral
item.description:
“I am not thinking about the NBA right now. The season is still very long and I am just focused to reach ACB playoffs in the best position for us. Now we have to be focused on Liga Endesa. Caja Laboral is a great team, but not because I am saying that, everybody knows that, from here to the States”

Mirza Teletovic on Caja Laboral, Feb 23, 2012. Source: Sportando.

item.title: Jose Juan Barea on Caja Laboral
item.description:
Barea:

“We're talking with Caja Laboral but there is nothing serious at this point.”

Jose Juan Barea on Caja Laboral, Nov 20, 2011. Source: El Nuevo Dia.
